name: 01-login
say: This is N C C D. It's a Mac app I'm making for the NELA Computer Club. When you open it, there are two ways in.

name: 02-qr
say: Link Signal, and scan the code with your phone. That opens our chats and circles.

name: 03-ncc
say: Or sign into N C C with your club account. That opens the wiki and the code. You can use one login without the other.

name: 04-donut
say: Home is a donut. Every chat is a token on it. Bigger means more members. A token that beats had a message a moment ago, and the newest message floats beside it.

name: 05-chat
say: Click one and you're in the chat. You can read, write, and mention people.

name: 06-circle
say: Each circle shows its roles across the top. Pictures, files and links show in line.

name: 07-pending

env.NCC_SNAPSHOT_PENDING: a message on its way glimmers until signal has it

say: When you send, your message shows right away, and glimmers until Signal has it.

name: 08-switcher
say: This little switcher gets you anywhere. Or use browser shortcuts. Control tab for the next place, command one through nine, and command plus and minus to zoom.

name: 09-wiki
say: The wiki is a tab. This is our starting page, straight from Outline.

name: 10-wikipage
say: Pages are drawn from their markdown, with tables and links. Links between pages open right here.

name: 11-code
say: The code tab is our Forgejo, already signed in.

name: 12-search
say: Search looks through every chat and the wiki at once.

name: 13-linked
say: Each login shows a tick. Press it again to unlink or sign out.

name: 14-about
say: New messages show up as Mac notifications, so Signal desktop can stay closed. It's written in Swift. Signal runs through signal C L I. The wiki is Outline, the code is Forgejo, and login is Authentik. It's signed, notarized, and it updates itself. The code is on our Forgejo. Feel free to try it.
